environment: Linux JDK 21, isolated clean checkouts, equivalent settings, bounded serialized runs, full preserved evidence and cleanup
head: faf1bae5f6eeb0917f27e142f1cb528268629280
phase: standalone baseline reproduction and causal diagnosis
requirements: Review predecessor receipt, evidence and release, and current heads and claims. This is a standalone diagnosis; do not duplicate an active worker. Record current upstream main, pinned main head, PR base 0ea013e782f747cc94e1504f8077f813d2ddcca8, contributor head 65c2d85f77017a951f20dc110d71bf14786c6694, and offered head a9e8ce1db89b0094fb16b90d41bce7402ed4407d. Use pinned heads for comparisons and note any changed head.

Source lead: bin/solr uses lsof to wait for TCP LISTEN, not for the deprecation warning; EnvUtils logs that warning during static initialization. Determine whether in the actual startup lifecycle listening can precede initialization and the BATS assertion. Verify lsof is present and identify its path and actual readiness mechanism; do not assume port binding proves application readiness or that this race actually occurred.

Capture full solr.log and console from the actual log directory, not merely SOLR_HOME, before and after assertion and teardown, regardless of outcome. Timestamp socket listening, start return, warning, assertion, and relevant process events in the same run. Preserve environment, environment variables relevant to logging, PID, per-run isolated paths, exit codes, test outputs, and evidence hashes. Prior failure logs were not preserved; successful separate logs cannot establish their cause.

Perform controlled, bounded comparisons on upstream PR base 0ea013e782f747cc94e1504f8077f813d2ddcca8, current pinned upstream main faf1bae5f6eeb0917f27e142f1cb528268629280, contributor head and offered head on the same host. Use equivalent CLI variant, JDK, environment, ports, security settings and setup, record all trials and avoid stale logs. Seek actual unmodified failure, including full-suite ordering and focused case as appropriate. If no failure, report non-reproduction and sample counts rather than concluding no effect or repeating indefinitely.

If source timing analysis supports it, use a labeled, reversible diagnostic perturbation that delays warning emission or initialization relative to port readiness. Show whether the original assertion fails and whether a bounded wait for the exact warning fixes it, while a missing/wrong warning still fails after the bound. Separate forced demonstration of a possible race from proof of the original failure, do not modify or push source branches. Investigate alternate explanations supported by captured evidence, including wrong log destination, file reset/truncation and logging initialization.

If a real cause is established, report a minimal standalone fix based on upstream main, applicable files, executable fail-before and pass-after plan, scope and any alternative explanation. Do not claim a separate patch or PR is ready without evidence. Run only further targeted proof necessary to support the diagnosis; preserve all runs and restore diagnostics. File evidence, receipt and release with cleanup and stop evidence. No public comment, PR or source push.
verdict_policy: Passed diagnosis requires preserved failing evidence and a supported causal mechanism, including comparison sufficient to establish whether the same failure can occur on upstream baseline. Non-reproduction, setup errors or a forced race alone are incomplete; report useful evidence and limitations.
